chronology: Official dev archive is reserved final data. Require every impression strictly later than the entire training archive, else halt without exclusions. Training/development labels never refit frozen models or popularity counts.
metadata: Training metadata wins shared IDs; record disagreements. New observed IDs use fixed title/category/subcategory SHA256 token hashing and frozen encoder. Existing vectors retained bitwise. Missing metadata, malformed or duplicate IDs halt without excluding events. Final impression namespace final: prevents archive ID collisions.
availability: Union of training and final history/exposure observations, first_seen strictly before query; current and equal-time new IDs excluded from retrieval. Earlier label-free exposures may add later catalog candidates. All logged positives remain in denominators, including unavailable/unretrieved items.
feedback: Pre-impression provided last20history and earlier same-user clicked groups. Seed session state from original training archive. Earlier final labels may update only later contexts, strictly after5minutes; gap>30minutes resets. Equal-time outcomes enter once as unordered centroid after all queries at that time. No click-order inference. This is a causal label-assisted replay, not globally label-free prediction.
selection: All learned weights, fixed epochs, counts, hashing, thresholds, policies and exclusions frozen before opening archive. No final-score tuning, checkpoint selection or holdout reruns.
catalog_arms: Popularity100; frozen content100; session relevance/fresh/balanced rank the deduplicated union of those two pools. No oracle injection. All original candidate pools and temporal conditions retained.
controls: Relevance rank scale; freshness exp(-age_hours/24),24hour decay scale (~16.64hour half-life). Freshweight.15;balanced freshness.10/redundancy.15;redundancy halfmaxcontentcosine/halfcategoryshare. Top10 controls then remaining model order.
metrics: All impressions, macro logged AUC,mean_clicked_rr,first_hit_rr,nDCG5/10,recall5/10; catalogrecall10/100,nDCG10,poolrecall;slatecategorycount,age,cosinediversity;daily,cold/warmusers,emptyhistory,coldpositivearticle,unseencontentpositive,with/withoutsession;fitexposurebins0/1-99/100-999/1000+;articlemacrorecall10;catalogcoverage. Zero-positive andone-class undefinedmetrics omitted withcounts,neverentireimpressions.
freeze_order: Prepare validated causal contexts; write every prediction without current label access; freeze predictionhashes; then aggregate current labels and independently audit all metrics. Labels necessarily parsed earlier for delayed contexts; timestamps report that fact.
audit: Independent raw TSV parsing, all contexts/history/labels/fitcounts/availability;fullpredictiondigest,allmetricgroups,exposure/coverage;128hash-selected exhaustivefloat64 retrievalqueries and512policydecisions;256reloadqueries perlearnedarm. Feature1e-6,ranking1e-10,age1e-8,cosinediversity1e-7,policy1e-6,FAISSscore1e-5/boundary1e-6.
limitations: One training seed; no statistical significance or live engagement claim.
No exposure propensities/randomization; no IPS or causal correction.
No documented timestamp timezone, publication times or text version history.
Missing catalog relevance is unknown; catalog recall uses only known logged positives, no full-catalog AUC.
No final cases or text enter the browsing demo. Public reports contain aggregates/hashes only.
original_input_hashes_note: Exact dataset, model, prepared-array and earlier-report hashes were verified before each stage. Public data/model/prepared-manifest hashes are in report.json; individual private paths and arrays are not redistributed.

pre_outcome_archive_wrapper_correction.scope: Initial guard required root TSV members; the official archive wraps them in MINDsmall_dev/. The failed guard read no TSV content/outcomes. Accept exactly one root/wrapped TSV member and reject ambiguity; no model, feature, metric or policy changed.
pre_outcome_archive_wrapper_correction.regression: Authored wrapper and ambiguous-member checks passed before successful preparation.
